name: Roundups.ai – Instant Product Roundups With AI
author: roundups

sections.description:
Let AI research products, write SEO-friendly guides, and help you earn affiliate income by helping others make informed buying decisions.

This plugin creates a secure bridge between your WordPress site and Roundups.ai, allowing you to easily generate product Roundups with Roundups.ai then securely access your draft Roundups through the plugin and easily publish to your WordPress.

This is built for:

  • Bloggers
  • Affiliate marketers
  • SEO creators
  • Newsletter writers
  • E-commerce businesses
  • Media companies

If you want to monetize products, Roundups makes it super easy saving you time, saving you money, and using AI to help you make money from high quality high conversion content.

Features

  • Use AI to research and generate buying guides that help others make informed buying decisions at Roundups.ai
  • Use the WordPress plugin to easily fetch drafts and publish your Roundups to your WordPress
  • Get paid when readers gain insight from your Roundups and click through to make purchases

Access thousands of products from marketplaces or import products with just an affiliate marketing URL. Our AI analyzes products and generates informative buying guides in seconds.

Review your AI-generated buying guide and use our editor to fine tune the output by adding your own personal touch.

Use our WordPress plugin to fetch your draft Roundups and publish to your WordPress. When your readers gain insight from your Roundups and click through to purchase, you’ll get paid!

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your WordPress in the Roundups.ai dashboard
  3. Generate a Roundup in the Roundups.ai dashboard
  4. Fetch draft Roundups through the plugin and publish to your WordPress

External Services

This plugin connects to the Roundups.ai API to securely publish content to your WordPress site.

What data is sent

  • Your Roundups.ai API key (for authentication)
  • Post content including title, body, categories, tags, excerpt, and featured image data

When data is sent

  • When verifying your site connection
  • When creating or updating posts
  • When fetching recent Roundups from your account

Service Information

Service: Roundups.ai
https://roundups.ai

Terms of Service:
https://roundups.ai/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://roundups.ai/privacy

Security Plugin Configuration

If you’re using security plugins, you’ll need to allowlist these endpoints:

REST API Endpoints

  • /wp-json/roundups/v1/verify
  • /wp-json/roundups/v1/posts

Alternative Endpoints

  • /roundups/v1/verify
  • /roundups/v1/posts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/roundups-ai/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins page
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Go to Settings → Roundups.ai
  4. Add your API key (Get this key in the Roundups.ai dashboard in the integrations tab)
  5. Fetch content created using the Roundups plugin
sections.faq:
Do I need a Roundups.ai account?

Yes. This plugin connects to your account created with Roundups.ai.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes. All content is published as standard WordPress posts and works with any theme.

Can I publish as a draft?

Yes. You control whether posts are created as drafts or published live.

Can I edit content after publishing?

Yes. Everything becomes a normal WordPress post.
